name: Sampo-MCP
description: Let AI access to local filesystem, hardware, software, network and much more.

repository.participate: Absolutely. Help from Linux and macOS users in particular would be a great, great, super great thing.

configDocs._description: Configuration field descriptions for INITS.md documentation generation
configDocs.installRoot: Absolute path to Sampo-MCP installation/source directory. Used by init.js to locate server files and create dev symlinks.
configDocs.workspaceRoot: Absolute path to the user's workspace root directory where all AI-accessible files are stored. All file operations are restricted to this directory for security.
configDocs.devMode: Enable development mode features: creates source code symlinks in workspace for AI access, enables automatic backups, and exposes developer tools.
configDocs.trashRoot: Folder name for trash directory (relative to workspace root). Deleted files are moved here before permanent deletion.
configDocs.jsonRoot: Folder name for JSON output files (relative to Sampo-docs). Search results and tool outputs are stored here.
configDocs.logs: Folder name for log files (relative to Sampo-docs). Server logs and error logs are written here.
configDocs.logFile: Filename for main server log. Contains general server messages and tool execution logs.
configDocs.errorLogFile: Filename for error log. Contains error messages and stack traces.
configDocs.sampoDocs: Main Sampo documentation folder name (relative to workspace root). Contains all generated documentation and user data.
configDocs.blockDocs: Folder name for block documentation (relative to Sampo-docs). Auto-generated documentation of code blocks.
configDocs.initDocs: Folder name for initialization documentation (relative to Sampo-docs). Contains INITS.md and configuration guides.
configDocs.toolDocs: Folder name for tool guides (relative to Sampo-docs). Individual markdown files for each MCP tool.
configDocs.devDocs: Folder name for developer documentation (relative to Sampo-docs). Technical documentation for Sampo-MCP development.
configDocs.userData: Folder name for user-specific data (relative to workspace root). General user files and data storage.
configDocs.enableHttp: Enable HTTP/REST API server. When true, Sampo-MCP exposes an HTTP interface in addition to stdio MCP protocol.
configDocs.httpPort: Port number for HTTP API server. Default is 3000.
configDocs.httpUrl: Base URL for HTTP API. Used for generating API documentation and links.
configDocs.protocolVersion: MCP (Model Context Protocol) version string. Defines which protocol features are supported.

cleanup._description: Automatic cleanup configuration. Manages old files to prevent disk space issues.
cleanup.trashRetentionDays: Number of days to keep files in trash before permanent deletion. Files older than this are automatically deleted.
cleanup.jsonRetentionDays: Number of days to keep old JSON output files. Helps prevent accumulation of search results and tool outputs.
cleanup.cleanupIntervalHours: Hours between automatic cleanup runs. Set to 24 for daily cleanup.

resources.maxRecentJsonFiles: Maximum number of recent JSON files to show in MCP resources list

initsDocs._description: Documentation for _INITS object properties exported from init.js

paths.workspacePath: Validated absolute path to workspace root. All file operations must be within this directory. Security boundary for AI file access.
paths.projectRoot: Absolute path to Sampo-MCP installation root. Points to where package.json and src/ folder are located.
paths.trashPath: Absolute path to trash folder for deleted files. Files are moved here before permanent deletion.
paths.jsonPath: Absolute path to JSON output folder. Search results, tool outputs, and structured data are stored here.
paths.logsPath: Absolute path to logs folder. Contains server log files and error logs.
paths.backupsPath: Absolute path to automatic backups folder (dev mode only). Stores timestamped backups of modified files.
paths.userDataPath: Absolute path to user data folder. General purpose storage for user files.
paths.userDiaryPath: Absolute path to diary data folder. Stores personal diary entries.
paths.userNotesPath: Absolute path to notes folder. Quick notes and annotations storage.
paths.userRemindersPath: Absolute path to reminders folder. Time-based reminders and notifications.
paths.sampoDocsPath: Absolute path to main Sampo documentation folder. Root for all generated documentation.
paths.blockDocsPath: Absolute path to block documentation folder. Auto-generated code block structure documentation.
paths.initsDocsPath: Absolute path to initialization documentation folder. Contains INITS.md and configuration documentation.
paths.toolDocsPath: Absolute path to tool guides folder. Individual markdown documentation for each MCP tool.
paths.devDocsPath: Absolute path to developer documentation folder. Technical documentation and development guides.
paths.logFile: Absolute path to main log file. Full path including filename for server logs.
paths.errorLogFile: Absolute path to error log file. Full path including filename for error tracking.

system_info.win: Boolean indicating if running on Windows platform. Used for platform-specific path handling and command execution.
system_info.arch: System architecture string (x64, arm64, etc.). Node.js os.arch() value.
system_info.platform: Operating system platform string (win32, linux, darwin). Node.js os.platform() value.
system_info.devMode: Boolean indicating if development mode is enabled. Controls dev symlinks, backups, and developer tools.

runtime_info.startup_time: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when server started. Used for uptime calculations and log timestamps.
runtime_info.server_root: Absolute path to server source code directory (src/ folder). Used for loading modules and generating documentation.
runtime_info.package_path: Absolute path to package.json file. Used for reading configuration and metadata.

sampo_metadata.Sampo_Name: Package name from package.json. Identifies the Sampo-MCP installation.
sampo_metadata.Sampo_MCP_version: Current Sampo-MCP version string. Semantic version (major.minor.patch).
sampo_metadata.Sampo_MCP_description: Package description from package.json. Brief summary of Sampo-MCP functionality.
sampo_metadata.Sampo_MCP_homepage: Project homepage URL. Links to GitHub repository or project website.
sampo_metadata.Sampo_MCP_license: Software license type (MIT). Defines usage and distribution rights.
sampo_metadata.Sampo_MCP_author: Author information object with name, email, and URL. Contact information for project maintainer.
sampo_metadata.Sampo_MCP_repository: Repository information object. Git repository URL and metadata.
sampo_metadata.Sampo_MCP_dependencies: Installed npm dependencies object. Maps package names to version ranges.
sampo_metadata.Sampo_MCP_engines: Required Node.js and npm versions object. Defines minimum engine versions.

http_config.Sampo_MCP_http: HTTP API base URL. Used when HTTP API is enabled for REST endpoints.
http_config.Sampo_MCP_port: HTTP API port number. Port where HTTP server listens when enabled.
http_config.Sampo_MCP_enableHttp: Boolean indicating if HTTP API is enabled. When false, only stdio MCP protocol is active.
http_config.Sampo_MCP_protocolVersion: MCP protocol version string. Defines which protocol features are supported.
